name: dev-team
description: A suite of team-lead/product-owner skills that delegate software work to a tiered team of Claude subagents (Fable/Opus/Sonnet/Haiku, see model-routing): orchestrator (build), iterate (improve), security (adversarial audit), review (QA), featurefind (competitive gap analysis), autopilot (autonomous drive to production), stripe (payments build/review), ship (CI/CD, branch protection, secret scanning, releases), and ci-medic (watch PRs + safe CI-failure resolution).
